_readme: Copy this file to offsets.json and fill in the four build offsets.
Every value is an RVA inside libil2cpp.so: the number you add to the
module base. 0 means 'not resolved yet' and is skipped by the loader.
offsets.json is read from the current working directory at startup:
put it next to HD-Player.exe (panel) or next to external.exe.
Get the numbers from your own Il2CppDumper run - see sdk/dump_placeholder.cs.
